card.name: The word American in names
card.fires_on: The word "American" (capitalized, with or without a leading space) in organization names, dictionary credits, and phrases like "American dream" or "American history".

modes.label: Organization names
modes.description: "American" starting the name of a society or association, often before a following noun like Association or Union.
